newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS first-half net profit rises 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: DBS first-half net profit rises 13 pct.

text.p: The Development Bank of Singapore (DBS) group said on Wednesday it posted net profits of Singapore $358.3 million (US$243.7 million), up 13 percent, for the six months ended June 30, 1997.
The results were in line with most analysts' expectations.
According to the Edinburgh Financial Publishing's Estimate Directory, the consensus forecast for the DBS group's net profit for the full year ending December 1997 is S$755.7 million.
A DBS statement said net interest income of the group grew by 11.6 percent to S$462.9 million on an expanded loan portfolio.
Group loans and advances ,including bills receivables, increased by 16.8 percent to S$35.8 billion.
Group fees and commission income rose by 15.7 percent to S$143.2 million due mainly to higher loans and trade-related activities, investment banking and stockbroking income.
Rental income was maintained at around the previous year's level at S$16.15 million. However other income declined by 21.9 percent due mainly to lower profits from trading activities.
